name: Imouto ni Doutei o Sute Sasete Moratta ~Tsundere Fuumi~
original_name: 妹に童貞を捨てさせてもらった～ツンデレ風味～
source:
"I'm begging you!
Take my virginity!
No... let me lose it to you!!"

One day brother went to his little sister's room to ask an unreasonable thing...

The story of a boy's first time.
